facts.text: The hotel is in the Arts and Garden District of Clayton, Missouri.
facts.excerpt: Tucked within the Arts and Garden District of Clayton, Missouri

facts.text: Casa Don Alfonso, the hotel's Italian restaurant, serves Southern Italian flavors.
facts.excerpt: Savor the flavors of Southern Italy at Casa Don Alfonso

facts.text: Casa Don Alfonso holds Wine Spectator's 2026 Best of Award of Excellence.
facts.excerpt: Wine Spectator’s 2026 Best of Award of Excellence - Casa Don Alfonso

facts.text: ACHI is an omakase experience with a 10-course tasting menu served at a 6-seat counter on select nights.
facts.excerpt: Behind an intimate 6-seat counter, our skilled Sushi Chefs (Itamae) work their magic on cutting boards right before your eyes. Join us for this unique dining experience on select nights.

facts.text: The Cigar Club is a private bar and lounge for cigar smoking, open only to overnight hotel guests and members; the rest of the hotel is smoke-free.
facts.excerpt: The Cigar Club is a private bar and lounge designed for those who choose to smoke cigars (the rest of the hotel is entirely smoke-free). Only overnight hotel guests and Cigar Club members have access to The Cigar Club.

facts.text: The rooms were completely transformed and feature Juliet balconies.
facts.excerpt: After a complete transformation, the new design blends contemporary luxury and classic styles and features Juliet balconies.

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 18th floor and overlooks the city's Garden and Cultural Arts District and the lights of Clayton.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the city’s Garden and Cultural Arts District and the twinkling evening lights of Clayton, the city’s financial center, stunning vistas complement the elegant ambiance of the 18th-floor Club® Lounge.

facts.text: Club guest rooms and suites are on the 17th and 18th floors, steps from the Club Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Guest rooms and suites are conveniently located on the 17th and 18th floors, making Club Lounge steps from your door — no elevator required.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers four presentations a day: breakfast, lunch, hors d'oeuvres and dessert.
facts.excerpt: With four presentations per day — breakfast, lunch, hors d'oeuvres, and dessert

facts.text: The spa's signature massages use ingredients such as Missouri red granite.
facts.excerpt: Spa treatments are focused on massage, with signature experiences incorporating ingredients such as red granite sourced from St. Louis area providers.

facts.text: The Missouri Black Walnut Massage uses sticks carved from locally sourced black walnuts.
facts.excerpt: Harnessing natural elements by using sticks carved from locally sourced Black walnuts

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and has natural daylight and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Louis Fitness Center is open 24 hours.

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes.
Young guests get a special registration experience and a hotel-wide scavenger hunt.
facts.excerpt: From a special registration experience to a hotel-filled scavenger hunt, the possibilities to explore are endless.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Casa Don Alfonso Pizza Making Class as a hotel experience.
facts.excerpt: experiences such as our Casa Don Alfonso Pizza Making Class or Healthy Mind & Body Yoga Class

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: The airport, St. Louis Lambert International, is 8.0 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: St. Louis Lambert International Airport Distance from Property: 8.0 Miles

facts.text: Guests must be 18 or older to access the spa facilities.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 18 or older to access the spa facilities.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.
